body.p: , after , , , , , . The EXPath Binary Module 4.0 is the optional feature sxml_expath_binary_feature() ("expath-binary").

item.p: Public, additive: include/sxml/processor.h declares the feature function. include/sxml/name.h (frozen by ) gains the well-known namespace SXML_NAMESPACE_EXPATH_BINARY = 13 (http://expath.org/ns/binary), so rows name their namespace as the fn, map and math rows do. SXML_NAMESPACE_WELL_KNOWN_COUNT is now 14: interned URIs start one later, which no caller sees.

Rows: 33 functions in src/function_library_binary.c, whose view is not named as a part, so they are the definition's library_functions (). The kind's operations table is that same view. Every binary parameter is (xs:hexBinary | xs:base64Binary); results are xs:base64Binary (1.2). The 4.0 types are kept: xs:unsignedByte for octets and the enum(...) octet order, so bad values are XPTY0004 as 4.0 says (appendix F), where the QT4 cases still expect bin:octet-out-of-range and bin:unknown-significance-order (26 wrong error codes, which count as passes).
Errors are in the bin namespace, prefix bin, filled into the error record directly (static text, ).

Text: the decoder of fn:unparsed-text moves to src/text_decoding.c (sxml_text_decoding_choose, sxml_text_decode). Its encoding choice was already written after bin:infer-encoding, so bin:infer-encoding and bin:decode-string use it unchanged. bin:encode-string encodes UTF-8, UTF-16 (big-endian, no mark), UTF-16BE/LE, ISO-8859-1 and US-ASCII. Encoding names are classified by sxml_xml_classify_encoding_name.
Integers beyond int64_t are packed and unpacked through their decimal text on base 10^9 limbs. bin:integer-too-large is raised past 4,096 octets (9,865 digits, inside the heap's decimal limit).

System property: the value kind DYNAMIC_XQUERY becomes KNOWN_FUNCTION, with a function name and arity in the row. supports-dynamic-xquery asks for fn:load-xquery-module#1 and supports-binary-library for bin:hex#1, so the property follows the configuration.

Hosts: the feature is in sxml_all_optional_features(), so the sxml command, the drivers and sxml-full.wasm have it, and sxml.wasm does not. The QT4 driver supports the dependency feature binary, and bin-* is no longer a non-goal set.

Counts (release driver, XP40 and XQ40 alike): bin-* 0 to 646 of 646, of which 26 have the wrong error code; fn-serialize 200 to 224 (XP40) and 258 to 282 (XQ40), the canonical-JSON cases that call bin:unpack-double; fn-system-properties 23 to 23 (the -false case is now not run, the true case passes).
